title: Anything You Can Code, I Can Code Better: Managed Run Apps vs Power Pages
summary: Head-to-head build of a workplace accommodation survey app as a Managed Run App and a Power Pages SPA across four rounds.
whyItMatters: Clearest decision rule: external users -> Power Pages; internal AI-built apps with Git ALM -> Managed Run App.

keyPoints.heading: Managed Run App
keyPoints.text: Safe place for AI to build with governance set; build in Copilot Studio Apps, Cowork (/app skill), GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, VS Code; uses environments for governance and billing; can connect to data in another environment; inventory in admin portal only.

keyPoints.heading: Power Pages SPA
keyPoints.text: Single-page site; styling lives in the React code.

keyPoints.heading: Round 1 - Build and navigate
keyPoints.text: SPA has unique URLs per view; Managed Run App supports deep links.

keyPoints.heading: Round 2 - Solutions and deployment
keyPoints.text: SPA is solution-aware (normal pipelines); Managed Run App is not - uses Git repos, pro-dev ALM; URL selects version, local, or prod.

keyPoints.heading: Round 3 - Data
keyPoints.text: SPA: Dataverse Web API, Power Automate for anything else. Managed Run App: any connector, custom Dataverse API, custom web API, Dataverse security.

keyPoints.heading: Round 4 - Server-side
keyPoints.text: SPA has server-side logic; Managed Run App sync calls have a 2-minute limit, use async for long work; both send telemetry.

keyPoints.heading: How to decide
keyPoints.text: External users -> Power Pages. Browser dependency is a consideration.
